RequiredFindings.Question: Q10
RequiredFindings.Defect: load_json accepts NaN, Infinity and -Infinity through json.loads' default parse_constant behavior, although these tokens are not JSON values. A token in a field not subsequently inspected, such as Attempt, does not cause any failed check. Preserving all inspected identity and scope fields therefore leaves a malformed evidence document able to reach PASS and exit 0 for an otherwise valid synthetic delivery. Duplicate-key rejection and strict UTF-8 decoding do not reject these constants. The committed 25-case self-test has no regression for this path.
RequiredFindings.Authority: A-3:95,98 adopts A-2 condition 8 at line 87 and A-1 Sec.3 at lines 97-105: parsing/evidence ambiguity must fail closed and inputs must be JSON. Owner mandate clause 4 requires unambiguous evidence and fail-closed handling. INITIATIVE_LIFECYCLE Sec.5 makes a defective frozen guarantee REQUIRED.
RequiredFindings.Correction: Pass a parse_constant callback that raises ValueError for NaN, Infinity and -Infinity. Add synthetic behavioral regressions for both delegation and handoff, placing the tokens in otherwise uninspected fields and requiring DELEGATION_UNREADABLE or HANDOFF_UNREADABLE with nonzero exit. Demonstrate those regressions failing against the authorized A-3 verifier and passing after correction. Preserve prior A-n and evidence; authorize the corrected blob and updated self-test through the next append-only A-n and review that exact object before use, as A-2:115-116 requires.

Limitations: Static review of pinned Git artifacts only. Neither verifier nor self-test was executed; committed results were inspected without independently reproducing them.
The new JSON-constant finding follows from decoder defaults and subsequent code paths; no runtime demonstration was performed.
No concrete T1 path was evaluated for AllowedWriteScope membership. Historical outcomes were read from versioned records.
No live remote state, CI, runtime eligibility, build, test suite or Owner validation was independently measured.
Initial shell calls emitted a profile-loading error. The affected Git reads and log were repeated successfully with login=false.
